title: When the Garden Falls
premise: Sebastian Kavanagh has spent ten years as the crown's food-taster, dosing himself with poisons until his body learned to survive them — and unknowingly awakening a rare gift: the ability to taste truth, memory, and intent in anything he consumes. When the queen's new inquisitor begins hunting the gifted to feed the court beneath the mountain, Sebastian flees into the Thornfell mountains he knows better than any lawman. There he discovers the hunt's true purpose: the court below is starving for souls, and the queen sold her own sister's soul decades ago to keep her throne. To end the winter that falls with the hunt, Sebastian must descend beneath the mountain, steal back the imprisoned soul using his gift as both weapon and key, and choose between exposing the queen — an act of justice that will shatter the kingdom — or protecting the loyal friends who would die for her lie.
about_author: Yara Crane is a former line cook who claims she can still taste a lie in a well-made sauce. She writes fantasy from a drafty farmhouse kitchen, where every manuscript must survive being read aloud over dinner.

chapters.title: The Taster's Tongue
chapters.summary: POV Sebastian. At a royal banquet, Sebastian tastes arsenic in the chancellor's wine and saves his life — but also tastes the poisoner's grief and certainty that the king deserves death. The inquisitor Maren Voss notices his reaction too closely. Emotional beat: unease; the gift he's hidden for years is becoming visible.

chapters.title: A Hunt Is Proclaimed
chapters.summary: POV Sebastian. The crown announces a purge of 'the gifted,' offering silver for denunciations. Sebastian watches neighbors inform on each other and realizes Voss suspects him specifically. He burns his records and slips out of the city through a smuggler's gate only he knows. Emotional beat: fear sharpening into resolve.

chapters.title: Thornfell Roads
chapters.summary: POV Sebastian. In the mountains, Sebastian seeks his old smuggling contact, Odile, but finds her village half-empty — taken by Voss's riders. He meets Wren, a gifted girl who hears truths in birdsong, fleeing the same hunt. Emotional beat: guilt; his roads were safe until the crown needed them.

chapters.title: What the Queen Sold
chapters.summary: POV Wren. Wren leads Sebastian to a hidden community of the gifted, where an exiled archivist reveals the truth: the endless early winters began the night Queen Isolde sold her sister Elira's soul to the court beneath the mountain. Emotional beat: revelation reframing everything — the hunt isn't persecution, it's harvest.

chapters.title: The Inquisitor's Mercy
chapters.summary: POV Maren Voss. Voss, herself secretly gifted and complicit, captures Odile and offers her freedom for Sebastian's location. Odile gives a false trail and pays with her life. Voss feels the first crack in her loyalty to the crown. Emotional beat: tragedy; even the hunter is hunted by what she serves.

chapters.title: Salt and Silver
chapters.summary: POV Sebastian. Grieving Odile, Sebastian agrees to help the gifted community strike back — poisoning the hunt's supply wagons with a tincture that lets the gifted taste their pursuers' fears. The plan works too well: Voss escalates, burning villages. Emotional beat: anger curdling into doubt about whether justice by sabotage saves anyone.

chapters.title: The Descent Bargain
chapters.summary: POV Sebastian. The archivist reveals the only way to free Elira's soul: someone must carry it out themselves, binding it with willing flesh. Sebastian volunteers — his immunity makes him the only one who can survive the court's poisoned hospitality. Wren insists on coming. Emotional beat: grim commitment; the cost is finally named.

chapters.title: Beneath the Mountain
chapters.summary: POV Sebastian. Descending through the smugglers' deepest tunnels, Sebastian and Wren reach the court beneath the mountain, where pale nobles feast on memories. Sebastian tastes his way past three trials of deception, trading true memories of Odile and the king for passage. Emotional beat: dread laced with wonder; corruption here is elegant, not monstrous.

chapters.title: The Long Winter Breaks
chapters.summary: POV Sebastian and Wren alternating. Sebastian finds Elira's soul caged in a chalice of frozen wine and drinks it free, while Wren's birdsong shatters the court's illusions. They flee as the mountain convulses, pursued by Voss, who at the last moment turns her blade on her own masters instead. Emotional beat: climax — sacrifice, betrayal reversed, and escape bought with blood.

chapters.title: Justice, Unwritten
chapters.summary: POV Sebastian. Elira, reborn in Sebastian's shadow, chooses mercy over vengeance: she exposes the queen's bargain to the assembled lords rather than killing her. The hunt dissolves; the gifted are pardoned under a new accord Sebastian refuses to sign, trusting no law with power again. He walks back into the Thornfells with Wren. Emotional beat: bittersweet resolution — justice kept outside the law, loyalty survived by telling the truth.
